import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    target=None
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or I[i][j]==bg: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); c.append((y,x))
                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and I[ny][nx]!=bg:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            cntc=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in c)
            if len(cntc)>1: target=(min(y for y,_ in c), min(x for _,x in c), max(y for y,_ in c), max(x for _,x in c))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=target
    maj=max(cntc.values())//1
    # majority color = most common within comp
    cc=Counter(I[y][x] for y,x in c)
    col=max(cc.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
    return [[col]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
D=G['Demo pair 1 input']
out=f(D)
print(out, out==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
import json as J
res=f(G['Test input']); print(J.dumps(res))
